SCOPE OF THIS FILE CHANGED ON 2026-08-05. `blocked` is now HARD findings only -- the four kinds that can end the channel or harm a real person: (1) scraped or third-party copyrighted production footage (a y2mate rip, broadcast news carrying a chyron/watermark/branded mic, another production's burned-in subtitles or title cards, copyrighted characters); (2) a real identifiable minor on screen; (3) a real named person's identity captioned onto a different real person, including a generated plate presented AS a named real person; (4) legible personal data of a real private individual. `blocked` is the ONLY key any tool reads. Everything else -- legible generic document props, 'CITY COP' invented insignia, wrong-city police cruisers, foreign locations standing in for the US, foreign-language signage, stock-photo cliches, sci-fi imagery, register mismatches, ruins, restraint imagery and subject bans from an episode's own spec -- moved to `quality_deferred` by owner decision to ship. Those findings are correct and are kept verbatim; they simply no longer block, because the reject rate they imply is one the archive cannot sustain and the calendar was empty. A row with no `episodes` key is global; a row WITH one binds only for those slugs. SCOPE EXTENDED 2026-08-25, narrowly: `blocked` also takes (5) an asset that BREAKS THE BUILD -- one the pre-render or post-render gate refuses, so leaving it in the pool costs a 2.5-hour render every run. This is not a re-opening of the taste rejects demoted on 08-05; those were demoted because enforcing them emptied the calendar, and a build-breaking file costs the calendar rather than saving it. Rows of this kind carry hard_category cat5_build_breaking_asset and MUST be episode-scoped.
